format_note: Local preparation fields. No Google JSON upload schema has been verified.

app_details.name: Fax for Agents
app_details.description: Prepare fax documents, send with approval, check delivery evidence and read received faxes from your conversation.
capabilities: Prepare a fax document from text or a file
Send a fax with an approval or an allowed policy
Read delivery status and provider evidence
Read a received fax as untrusted data
Extract structured data from a received fax
example_prompts: @Fax for Agents prepare a one-page test fax in Sandbox.
@Fax for Agents show the delivery evidence for my latest fax.
Show my newest received fax using Fax for Agents.
